nom: Xitoy hukumati stipendiyasi (Chinese Government Scholarship, CSC)

nimani_qoplaydi.qiymat: To'liq stipendiya: o'qish to'lovidan ozod qilish, yotoqxona yoki uy-joy subsidiyasi, oylik stipendiya (bakalavr: oyiga 2 500 CNY), tibbiy sug'urta; qisman stipendiya ularning bir yoki bir nechtasini qoplaydi

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Fuqarolik: Xitoy Xalq Respublikasi fuqarosi bo'lmagan, jismonan va ruhan sog'lom shaxs
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Yosh va ta'lim darajasi: bakalavr uchun o'rta maktab bitiruvchisi, ariza paytida 25 yoshdan kichik
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: be a high school graduate under the age of 25 when applying for undergraduate programs

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Imtihon: 2026/2027 o'quv yilidan bakalavr arizachilari CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) imtihonini topshirib, amaldagi natijani yuklashi shart
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: Bachelor degree seeking program applicants is required to take the

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Imtihon: CSCA natijasi 2025-yil 1-martdan keyingi sinovdan bo'lishi kerak; qaysi fanlar kerakligini tanlangan universitetdan so'rash kerak
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: with a test date after March 1st, 2025

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Baholar va til: tanlangan universitetning bilim, til va boshqa qabul talablariga javob berish
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: meet the admission requirements of the applied universities

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Til (Pekin shahar hukumati sahifasi, 2020): bakalavr stipendiatlari xitoy tilidagi dasturlarda o'qiydi va odatda bir yillik tayyorlov kursini o'taydi
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: Undergraduate scholarship recipients must register for Chinese-taught credit courses.

kim_topshira_oladi.qiymat: Boshqa stipendiya: CSC stipendiati bir vaqtda Xitoy hukumati yoki universitetning boshqa stipendiyasini (bir martalik mukofotlardan tashqari) ololmaydi
kim_topshira_oladi.manba_iborasi: are not allowed to obtain other scholarships (excluding one-time awards)

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: O'qish to'lovi: to'liq stipendiyada o'qish to'lovidan ozod qilinadi (Pekin shahar hukumati sahifasi, 2020)
Yotoqxona: bepul universitet yotoqxonasi yoki uy-joy subsidiyasi (2020)
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy.

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Yotoqxona: kampusdan tashqarida yashashga ruxsat bo'lsa, bakalavr uchun subsidiya oyiga 700 CNY (2020)
Qisman stipendiya: to'liq stipendiya bandlaridan faqat bittasi yoki bir nechtasi (2020)
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: One or some items of the full scholarship.

nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.qiymat: Aviachipta: Indoneziya bilan dastur e'lonida (2027/2028) xalqaro yo'l xarajati qoplanmasligi yozilgan; O'zbekiston uchun alohida ma'lumot topilmadi
nimani_qoplaydi_batafsil.manba_iborasi: Does not include international travel expenses

hujjatlar.qiymat: Xitoy hukumati stipendiyasi ariza shakli (xitoy yoki ingliz tilida)
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English).

hujjatlar.qiymat: Pasportning ma'lumot sahifasi; o'qish boshlanishidan hisoblaganda amal qilish muddati 12 oydan kam bo'lsa, pasportni yangilash kerak
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: If the validity period of the currently held passport is less than 12 months

hujjatlar.qiymat: Eng yuqori ta'lim hujjati (notarial tasdiqlangan); hali bitirmaganlar maktabdan o'quvchi ekanini tasdiqlovchi rasmiy hujjat beradi
Baholar varaqasi; xitoy yoki ingliz tilida bo'lmasa, notarial tasdiqlangan tarjima bilan
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations

hujjatlar.qiymat: Til sertifikati: boshqa tilda o'qitiladigan dasturlar uchun universitet talabiga ko'ra IELTS yoki TOEFL kabi natija
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: such as IELTS or TOEFL score reports, in accordance with the requirements of each university

hujjatlar.qiymat: CSCA natijasi (bakalavr arizachilari uchun, ariza paytida amalda bo'lishi kerak)
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Applicants for bachelor’s degree programs must hold a valid score report of the CSCA

hujjatlar.qiymat: Oldindan qabul hujjati (pre-admission): tanlangan universitetlardan kamida bittasidan
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Applicants must provide at least one of pre-admission documents from the universities they applied for.

hujjatlar.qiymat: O'qish rejasi (xitoy yoki ingliz tilida, bakalavr uchun kamida 200 so'z)
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: A minimum of 200 words for undergraduates

hujjatlar.qiymat: San'at yoki dizayn yo'nalishi uchun: o'z ishlaringiz namunasi
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: To apply for art or design related majors

hujjatlar.qiymat: 18 yoshga to'lmaganlar: Xitoydagi qonuniy vasiyning hujjatlari
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Applicants under the age of 18 should submit the valid documents of their legal guardians in China.

hujjatlar.qiymat: Chet elliklar uchun tibbiy ko'rik shakli (Foreigner Physical Examination Form, inglizcha; natija 6 oy amal qiladi)
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English

hujjatlar.qiymat: Sudlanmaganlik haqida ma'lumotnoma (odatda ariza topshirishdan oldingi 6 oy ichida berilgan)
hujjatlar.manba_iborasi: certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority

tavsif.qiymat: Bakalavr arizachisi ariza topshirish paytida amaldagi CSCA natijasiga ega bo'lishi kerak (ro'yxat: csca.cn)
tavsif.manba_iborasi: must hold a valid score report of the CSCA at the time of application

tavsif.qiymat: campuschina.org da universitet va dasturlarni ko'rib, tanlangan universitetlar bilan bog'lanib, oldindan qabul hujjatini olish
tavsif.manba_iborasi: contact their favorite Chinese universities and obtain the Pre-Admission Documents

tavsif.qiymat: Ariza va hujjatlar campuschina.org tizimida onlayn topshiriladi
tavsif.manba_iborasi: and the corresponding application documents should be submitted in the system

tavsif.qiymat: Natija tizimda ko'riladi; g'oliblar qabul xati va JW201 viza shaklini tizimdan yuklab oladi
tavsif.manba_iborasi: download the admission notice and JW201 visa form from the system

ariza_yoli.qiymat: Onlayn: Study in China portali (campuschina.org) orqali, ariza qabul qiluvchi tashkilot (agency) raqami bilan; har davlat uchun raqam o'z elchixonasi e'lonida beriladi (O'zbekiston uchun e'lon topilmadi)
ariza_yoli.manba_iborasi: Please sign up and apply via Study in China homepage (http://www.campuschina.org)

rasmiy_faq.savol: 2027/2028 arizasi oldingi yillardan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

javob.qiymat: 2026/2027 o'quv yilidan boshlab bakalavr arizachilari CSCA imtihonini topshirib, amaldagi natijani ariza hujjati sifatida yuklashi shart
javob.manba_iborasi: upload a valid score as application document

rasmiy_havolalar.nom: Xitoyning AQShdagi elchixonasi: 2027/2028 ariza e'loni va savol-javob
Xitoyning Indoneziyadagi elchixonasi: 2027/2028 ariza e'loni (shartlar va hujjatlar)
Pekin shahar hukumati: Xitoy hukumati stipendiyalari (2020, qoplash jadvali)
